The use of a prebuilt binary (AppImage) is common in `-bin` packages, and while users must trust the upstream provider (in this case, the GitHub release), this does not constitute a supply-chain attack in the packaging layer. The source and checksums are consistent with the declared version and upstream. No evidence of malicious intent or code injection is present in the `.SRCINFO` file itself.
